## Overview

Adds NVIDIA Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe (`Nemotron3_5TranscribeForConditionalGeneration`), a speech-language model: a
native audio tower whose embeddings replace `<|audio|>` placeholders in the prompt of the existing NemotronH decoder.
It loads the released checkpoint `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B` and its FP8 and NVFP4 variants, serves
chat completions with audio and `/v1/audio/transcriptions`, and supports MTP and DFlash2 speculative decoding. The PR adds model files plus
the usual registry, config, docs and test entries, and, in its own commit, a small DFlash2 fix in shared
speculative-decoding code; it does not change the engine, scheduler or API server.

## Claims

- New architectures `Nemotron3_5TranscribeForConditionalGeneration` and `Nemotron3_5TranscribeMTPModel` (MTP draft).
- Native audio tower: log-mel features, the Parallel Expert Encoder (a transformer ASR encoder and an online
  Sortformer speaker branch, fused), and a projection. No Transformers implementation is needed.
- Loads the released checkpoint's NeMo SpeechLM layout (`model_type: nemo_speechlm`, architecture
  `Nemotron3_5TranscribeForConditionalGeneration`). The checkpoint's CTC timestamp head is skipped; word timestamps
  are a planned follow-up.
- Loads the FP8 and NVFP4 repos (`-FP8`, `-NVFP4`; ModelOpt FP8 and mixed FP8/NVFP4 recipes). Their decoder uses
  Hugging Face NemotronH names, one tensor per expert. The audio tower's linear layers are vLLM `ReplicatedLinear`
  layers built with the quantization config, so the recipe quantizes the ASR encoder to FP8 as it does the decoder.
  The MTP draft keeps the recipe, so the FP8 MTP head loads with its scales.
- Audio batching: a clip is batched only with clips that span as many 40 s encoder windows, and padding frames are
  zeroed before the speaker head's convolution, so a clip's result does not depend on its batch.
- `/v1/audio/transcriptions` splits long audio into pieces of up to one hour; a chat request takes one clip of up to
  one hour by default.
- DFlash2 works with this target. On main, a request in chunked prefill anchored on `<|audio|>`, past the draft
  vocabulary, and the selector's codebook lookup failed a device-side assert. The DFlash2 commit clamps the anchor
  and keeps top-k candidates inside the draft vocabulary.
- Accuracy matches the NeMo reference implementation within its run-to-run spread on the Open ASR Leaderboard
  English and multilingual quick sets; with the FP8 and NVFP4 repos, WER stays within 0.1 of the NeMo reference
  running the same checkpoints, and MTP accepts as many drafts.

## Validation

Quick set v2 (18,341 English and 15,486 multilingual clips; greedy; Skills scorer):

| Run | WER (%), English | WER (%), multilingual |
|---|---:|---:|
| This PR's model code on vLLM main (`6ae62b5368`) | 3.89 | 4.91 |
| Same model code on vLLM v0.32.0 | 3.88 | 4.88 |
| NeMo reference (vLLM plugin), two runs | 3.87 | 4.98 |
| FP8 repo, this PR | 3.92 | 5.10 |
| FP8 repo, NeMo reference | 3.86 | 5.02 |
| NVFP4 repo (FP8 KV cache), this PR | 3.94 | 5.22 |
| NVFP4 repo (FP8 KV cache), NeMo reference | 3.88 | 5.16 |

The released checkpoints' loaded weights are byte-identical to the checkpoints behind this table; only their CTC
timestamp heads, which are not loaded, differ. With NVFP4, this PR's transcripts agree with the NeMo reference's as
often as two NeMo reference runs agree with each other (80% of English clips).

Served smoke on vLLM main with the released checkpoint (one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, MTP2, the checkpoint's chat
template):
- 24/24 quick-set clips give the same transcript through `/v1/audio/transcriptions` and `/v1/chat/completions`.
- An unknown language code and the translation task return HTTP 400.
- MTP2 mean acceptance length 2.90 of 3 in the server's last logged interval (per position 95.8% and 94.2%).

The same smoke with DFlash2 K=7 (`nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-DFlash2`): 24/24 clips give the same
transcript on both endpoints; draft acceptance 75% and 82% in two runs' last logged intervals (mean acceptance
length 6.3 and 6.7 of 8). Without the DFlash2 commit, the engine stops with a device-side assert.

The same smoke with the FP8 and NVFP4 repos (`--gpu-memory-utilization 0.75`; NVFP4 with `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`):
MTP2 mean acceptance length 2.97 (FP8) and 2.94 (NVFP4, as the NeMo reference); DFlash2 K=7 on NVFP4 5.7 of 8. FP8
gives the same transcript on both endpoints for 24/24 clips, NVFP4 for 18 to 21 of 24, the others differing on near
ties (a comma, "we'll" for "will"). Without the MTP recipe fix, MTP2 accepted 1 to 2% of drafts.

Tests and checks on vLLM main (`a75277a0a1`, with CUDA hidden):
- `pytest tests/models/multimodal/processing/test_nemotron3_5_transcribe.py`: 23 passed. Three of them load a
  `config.json` through vLLM: the released layout builds a `ModelConfig`, and NeMo's generic architecture is refused,
  with the `architectures` value to set when the checkpoint has this model's structure (fails without the hint) and
  with a pointer to the NeMo Speech vLLM plugin otherwise. A tiny audio tower checks the embedding count per audio
  length and that each clip encodes as if alone (fails without the padding fix); an FP8 recipe quantizes exactly the
  ASR encoder's linear layers and their scalar scales load; the decoder renamer reads both checkpoint layouts; the MTP
  draft config keeps the quantization recipe (fails without the fix); a non-audio modality is refused.
- `pytest tests/models/test_registry.py -k "Nemotron3_5 or coverage"`: 3 passed.
- `pytest tests/models/test_initialization.py -k Nemotron3_5Transcribe`, which the online registry entries enable: 2
  passed on one GPU, for `Nemotron3_5TranscribeForConditionalGeneration` and `Nemotron3_5TranscribeMTPModel` (dummy
  weights, one decoder layer), with the entries online and the Hub repo read with an access token before launch.
- `pytest tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dflash2.py`: 106 passed on one GPU; on the CPU platform (CUDA hidden), 14 passed
  and 92 skipped (they need CUDA). The two new CPU tests, for the anchor clamp and for top-k past the processor's
  vocabulary, fail without the DFlash2 commit.
- `pytest tests/v1/spec_decode/test_lilicorr.py`: 33 passed. The DFlash2 commit moves the padding mask of
  `get_top_tokens` and `get_top_k_tokens` into `_mask_outside_vocab`, which also reads `org_vocab_size`. This test
  calls `get_top_k_tokens` with a `SimpleNamespace` as `self`, so its stand-in now has both; without that test-only
  change, two cases fail with `AttributeError`.
- `pre-commit run --all-files --hook-stage manual`, as CI runs it: all hooks pass.
- `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`: no GPU-to-host sync on the inference path (clip lengths stay on the host).

CI coverage: the Hub repos became public at the launch, after this PR opened, so here both registry entries still set
`is_available_online=False`.
CI runs the import and interface checks in `tests/models/test_registry.py` and the CPU tests above (the CPU multimodal
processor step collects `tests/models/multimodal/processing`); `tests/models/test_initialization.py` and the shared
processor tests skip the model. A follow-up PR sets the entries online once the repos are public. The local runs above
cover those tests, loading, generation and MTP; a short generation test can follow.

On this branch (two RTX PRO 6000, MTP2, 24 clips through both endpoints), TP=2 and DP=2 serve every clip; 21 of 24
transcripts are identical to one GPU, and the others differ only in spelling or punctuation. Earlier, with the same
model code on vLLM v0.32.0: TP=2 and DP=2 match one GPU; DFlash2 and MTP2 keep accuracy on
the quick set.

Reproduce:

```bash
vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B \
  --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}' \
  --speculative-config '{"model": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}'
curl http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions -F model=nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B \
  -F file=@clip.wav
# DFlash2 instead of MTP:
#   --speculative-config '{"method": "dflash", "model": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-DFlash2",
#                          "num_speculative_tokens": 7}'
# FP8 or NVFP4: serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B-FP8 or ...-NVFP4 the same way (MTP from the
# same repo); NVFP4 was validated with --kv-cache-dtype fp8.
```

## Details

- Native tower: the audio encoder has no public Transformers implementation, so it is implemented in vLLM, with the
  NeMo checkpoint names (`perception.*`).
- Names: the checkpoint declares `nemo_speechlm`, the model type of every NeMo SpeechLM checkpoint; the architecture
  name selects this model. The config class refuses other NeMo SpeechLM architectures. A checkpoint with this model's
  structure (the Parallel Expert Encoder on a NemotronH decoder) under NeMo's generic name, as older exports have,
  gets the `architectures` value to set in its `config.json`; others are pointed to the NeMo Speech vLLM plugin.
- MTP: the drafter shares the target's embedding and LM head. Its weight filter accepts the checkpoint's `llm.mtp.*`
  names, so a sharded checkpoint loads only the shards that hold the MTP head.
- DFlash2 fix (separate commit): the anchor clamp in `qwen3_dflash2.py`; `get_top_k_tokens` and `get_top_tokens` in
  `logits_processor.py` mask columns past the processor's vocabulary, as `_get_logits` drops them; the DFlash2
  candidate processor is sized by `min(get_vocab_size(), config.vocab_size)`, so targets whose vocabulary is not
  larger than the draft's behave as before. The 10 head rows past the draft vocabulary are zero, so the candidate
  path rarely fires; the anchor path crashed every smoke run.
- Pre-review: @Isotr0py reviewed this change privately before the launch and approved it.
- Model Runner V2 only: all validation ran on V2, the default on main.
- The decoder's Mamba SSM state dtype comes from the decoder config (`MODELS_CONFIG_MAP` entry), as for NemotronH.
- Long audio: the encoder cache is sized from the `--limit-mm-per-prompt` audio length, so a longer configured clip
  is admitted. Server-wide decode limits (`VLLM_MAX_AUDIO_DECODE_DURATION_S`, 600 s by default, and the 25 MB upload
  limit) still apply and are documented in the supported-models note.
- Thinking: the chat template turns thinking on by default; transcription servers should pass
  `--default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'` (documented).
- Limitation: the audio tower runs replicated on every tensor-parallel rank.
- Quantized repos: `hf_to_vllm_mapper` maps the recipe's layer names (`backbone.*`, `lm_head`, `perception.*`) onto
  `language_model.*` and `audio_tower.*`. The tower's linear layers flatten their input to 2-D, because vLLM's
  quantized kernels take `(tokens, features)`. The NVFP4 recipe declares no KV-cache quantization; the NeMo reference
  ran it with `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, as did the validation above. vLLM's FP8 linear layer adds the bias after
  rounding, where the NeMo reference adds it inside the CUTLASS kernel (one bf16 step on some elements).
- Memory note: the quick-set runs on main used `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192
  --max-num-seqs 512` on one 96 GB GPU (0.75 for the FP8 and NVFP4 repos). FlashInfer's autotune runs after vLLM's
  memory plan: with 32,768 batched tokens, start-up ran out of memory at both 0.85 and 0.80, and the NVFP4 repo did at
  0.85 even with 8,192. This is not specific to this model.
- Not in this PR: CTC word timestamps (follow-up through the transcription API, with forced alignment) and the
  Transformers-layout conversion of the checkpoint (Hugging Face's Transformers port uses its own layout and
  `model_type`).
- Duplicate check: no open PR adds this architecture.

  ran it with `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, as did the validation above. vLLM's FP8 linear layer adds the bias after
  rounding, where the NeMo reference adds it inside the CUTLASS kernel (one bf16 step on some elements).
- Memory note: the quick-set runs on main used `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192
  --max-num-seqs 512` on one 96 GB GPU (0.75 for the FP8 and NVFP4 repos). FlashInfer's autotune runs after vLLM's
  memory plan: with 32,768 batched tokens, start-up ran out of memory at both 0.85 and 0.80, and the NVFP4 repo did at
  0.85 even with 8,192. This is not specific to this model.
- Not in this PR: CTC word timestamps (follow-up through the transcription API, with forced alignment) and the
  Transformers-layout conversion of the checkpoint (Hugging Face's Transformers port uses its own layout and
  `model_type`).
- Duplicate check: no open PR adds this architecture.

+import json
+from typing import Any

+import pytest
+import torch

+from vllm.transformers_utils.configs.nemotron3_5_transcribe import (
+    SPEECHLM_EMBED_EXTRA_ROWS,
+    Nemotron3_5TranscribeConfig,
+    _checked_online,
+    _preprocessor_config,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.cpu_test
+
+ONLINE = {
+    "window_frames": 500,
+    "left_context_frames": 50,
+    "right_context_frames": 50,
+    "fifo_len": 40,
+    "spkcache_update_period": 300,
+    "spkcache_len": 188,

+
+AUDIO_CONFIG = {
+    "preprocessor": {"sample_rate": 16000, "n_fft": 512, "hop_length": 160},
+    "asr_encoder": {"subsampling_factor": 8},
+}
+
+
+def test_default_preprocessor_resolves():
+    preprocessor = _preprocessor_config({"normalize": None})
+    assert (preprocessor["n_mels"], preprocessor["win_length"]) == (64, 320)
+    # n_fft defaults to the next power of two at or above the window length.
+    assert preprocessor["n_fft"] == 512
+    longer_window = _preprocessor_config({"normalize": None, "window_size": 0.05})
+    assert longer_window["n_fft"] == 1024

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("setting", "message"),
+    [
+        ({}, "normalize"),  # NeMo normalizes per feature when the key is missing.
+        ({"normalize": "per_feature"}, "normalize"),
+        ({"normalize": None, "log": False}, "log-mel"),
+        ({"normalize": None, "log_zero_guard_type": "clamp"}, "log_zero_guard_type"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_unsupported_mel_settings_are_refused(setting, message):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=message):
+        _preprocessor_config(setting)
+
+
+def test_window_settings():
+    assert _checked_online(dict(ONLINE)) == ONLINE
+    for key, value in (
+        ("window_frames", 0),
+        ("left_context_frames", -1),
+        ("right_context_frames", -1),
+        ("fifo_len", -1),
+        ("spkcache_update_period", 0),
+        ("spkcache_len", 0),
+    ):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=key.split("_")[0]):
+            _checked_online(ONLINE | {key: value})
+
+
+def test_transcription_pieces_fit_the_context():
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.nemotron3_5_transcribe import (
+        _transcription_clip_s,
+    )
+
+    assert _transcription_clip_s(AUDIO_CONFIG, 65536) == 3600  # one hour at most
+    # 12.5 audio tokens and 4 transcript tokens per second in 16,384 - 256 tokens.
+    assert _transcription_clip_s(AUDIO_CONFIG, 16384) == 977
+    assert _transcription_clip_s(AUDIO_CONFIG, 300) == 2
+
+
+def test_audio_length_sets_the_largest_clip():
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.nemotron3_5_transcribe import (
+        _max_audio_samples,
+        _num_audio_embeddings,
+    )
+
+    def max_tokens(length, seq_len=65536):
+        samples = _max_audio_samples(AUDIO_CONFIG, seq_len, length)
+        return _num_audio_embeddings(AUDIO_CONFIG, samples)
+
+    assert max_tokens(None) == 45_000  # one hour by default
+    # 69 minutes, as `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{"audio": {"length": 66240000}}'`
+    # sets it, so a 65-minute clip (48,750 embeddings) fits the encoder cache.
+    assert max_tokens(66_240_000) == 51_750
+    # Never more than the context holds beside a short prompt.
+    assert max_tokens(115_200_000) == 65_536 - 256
+
+
+ENCODER = {
+    "d_model": 64,
+    "n_heads": 2,
+    "n_layers": 1,
+    "self_attention_model": "rope",
+    "subsampling_factor": 8,
+}
+
+# The smallest config.json in the released checkpoint's NeMo SpeechLM layout.
+CHECKPOINT_CONFIG: dict[str, Any] = {
+    "architectures": ["Nemotron3_5TranscribeForConditionalGeneration"],
+    "model_type": "nemo_speechlm",
+    "llm_config": {"model_type": "nemotron_h", "hidden_size": 64, "vocab_size": 1000},
+    "perception": {
+        "preprocessor": {"features": 128, "normalize": None, "window_size": 0.025},
+        "modality_adapter": {"_target_": "IdentityConnector", "d_model": 64},
+        "output_dim": 64,
+    },
+    "pe_encoder_config": {
+        "asr_encoder_type": "transformer",
+        "asr_encoder_cfg": ENCODER,
+        "diarization_model_cfg": {
+            "encoder": ENCODER,
+            "high_resolution": True,
+            "sortformer_modules": {"use_learnable_sil_emb": True},
+        },
+        "speaker_feature_mode": "thresholded",
+        "speaker_activity_threshold": 0.5,
+    },
+}
+
+
+def test_released_checkpoint_layout_loads(tmp_path):
+    from vllm.config import ModelConfig
+
+    (tmp_path / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(CHECKPOINT_CONFIG))
+    config = ModelConfig(str(tmp_path)).hf_config
+    assert isinstance(config, Nemotron3_5TranscribeConfig)
+    preprocessor = config.audio_config["preprocessor"]
+    assert (preprocessor["win_length"], preprocessor["hop_length"]) == (400, 160)
+    assert config.audio_config["online"] == ONLINE
+    # The audio placeholder sits in embedding rows past the trained vocabulary.
+    assert config.output_vocab_size == 1000
+    assert config.text_config.vocab_size == 1000 + SPEECHLM_EMBED_EXTRA_ROWS
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("changes", "hint"),
+    [

+        (
+            {},
+            'set "architectures": ["Nemotron3_5TranscribeForConditionalGeneration"]',
+        ),
+        # Another NeMo SpeechLM: no Parallel Expert Encoder.
+        ({"pe_encoder_config": None}, "NeMo Speech vLLM plugin"),
+    ],

+def test_other_nemo_speechlm_architectures_are_refused(tmp_path, changes, hint):
+    from vllm.transformers_utils.config import get_config
+
+    other = (
+        CHECKPOINT_CONFIG
+        | changes
+        | {"architectures": ["NeMoSpeechLMForConditionalGeneration"]}
+    )
+    (tmp_path / "config.json").write_text(json.dumps(other))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as excinfo:
+        get_config(str(tmp_path), trust_remote_code=False)
+    assert hint in str(excinfo.value)

+def _tiny_encoder(d_model: int, rotary_fraction: float, qk_norm: bool) -> dict:
+    return {
+        "feat_in": 16,
+        "d_model": d_model,
+        "n_heads": 4,
+        "n_layers": 2,
+        "ff_expansion": 4.0,
+        "qkv_bias": False,
+        "qk_norm": qk_norm,
+        "pre_block_norm": True,
+        "subsampling_factor": 8,
+        "rope_base": 10000.0,
+        "rotary_fraction": rotary_fraction,
+        "xscaling": False,
+    }
+
+
+# 0.8 s windows, so a few seconds of audio spans several windows and fills and
+# compresses the speaker cache. Continuous speaker features carry the speaker
+# probabilities into the embeddings unthresholded.
+TINY_AUDIO_CONFIG = {
+    "preprocessor": {
+        "sample_rate": 16000,
+        "win_length": 400,
+        "hop_length": 160,
+        "n_fft": 512,
+        "n_mels": 16,
+        "preemph": 0.97,
+        "log_zero_guard_value": 2**-24,
+        "mag_power": 2.0,
+        "pad_value": 0.0,
+    },
+    "asr_encoder": _tiny_encoder(32, 0.5, True),
+    "speaker_encoder": _tiny_encoder(24, 1.0, False),
+    "sortformer": {
+        "num_speakers": 4,
+        "fc_d_model": 24,
+        "tf_d_model": 12,
+        "spkcache_sil_frames_per_spk": 1,
+        "pred_score_threshold": 0.25,
+        "max_index": 99999,
+        "scores_boost_latest": 0.05,
+        "strong_boost_rate": 0.75,
+        "weak_boost_rate": 1.5,
+        "min_pos_scores_rate": 0.5,
+    },
+    "online": {
+        "window_frames": 10,
+        "left_context_frames": 2,
+        "right_context_frames": 2,
+        "fifo_len": 3,
+        "spkcache_update_period": 6,
+        "spkcache_len": 12,
+    },
+    "fusion": {
+        "speaker_feature_mode": "continuous",
+        "speaker_activity_threshold": None,
+        "spk_kernel_scale": 1.0,
+    },
+    "projection": {"input_dim": 32, "output_dim": 40},
+}
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def tiny_tower(dist_init):
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ReplicatedLinear
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.nemotron3_5_transcribe_audio import (
+        Nemotron3_5TranscribeAudioTower,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    tower = Nemotron3_5TranscribeAudioTower(TINY_AUDIO_CONFIG).eval()
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        # vLLM's linear layers allocate their weights uninitialized.
+        for module in tower.modules():
+            if isinstance(module, ReplicatedLinear):
+                module.weight.normal_(0.0, module.input_size**-0.5)
+                if module.bias is not None:
+                    module.bias.normal_(0.0, 0.1)
+        featurizer = tower.preprocessor.featurizer
+        featurizer.fb.uniform_()
+        window = torch.hann_window(featurizer.win_length, periodic=False)
+        featurizer.window.copy_(window)
+        sortformer = tower.encoder.diarization_model.sortformer_modules
+        sortformer.learnable_sil_emb.normal_()
+        for module in tower.modules():
+            if isinstance(module, torch.nn.LayerNorm):
+                module.weight.normal_(1.0, 0.1)
+                module.bias.normal_(0.0, 0.1)
+        # Weight loading ends with this step; on CPU it selects the GEMM kernel.
+        for module in tower.modules():
+            if isinstance(module, ReplicatedLinear):
+                module.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(module)
+    return tower
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_samples", [160, 161, 1_281, 12_345, 12_960, 48_001])
+def test_audio_tower_returns_one_embedding_per_audio_token(tiny_tower, num_samples):
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.nemotron3_5_transcribe import (
+        _num_audio_embeddings,
+    )
+
+    clip = torch.randn(num_samples) * 0.1
+    with torch.inference_mode():
+        (embeddings,) = tiny_tower.encode([clip], torch.tensor([num_samples]))
+    num_tokens = _num_audio_embeddings(TINY_AUDIO_CONFIG, num_samples)
+    assert embeddings.shape == (num_tokens, 40)
+
+
+def test_decoder_weights_read_both_checkpoint_layouts():
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.nemotron3_5_transcribe import (
+        Nemotron3_5TranscribeForConditionalGeneration as Model,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.nemotron3_5_transcribe import _decoder_weights
+
+    nemo = {
+        "llm.model.embed_tokens.weight": torch.ones(8, 4),
+        "llm.model.layers.0.mixer._fp32_params.A_log": torch.ones(2),
+        "llm.model.layers.1.mixer.experts.down_projs": torch.arange(24.0).view(2, 3, 4),
+        "llm.model.norm.weight": torch.ones(4),
+    }
+    # The FP8 and NVFP4 checkpoints: Hugging Face names, one tensor per expert.
+    hf = {
+        "backbone.embeddings.weight": torch.ones(8, 4),
+        "backbone.layers.1.mixer.experts.0.up_proj.weight_scale": torch.ones(()),
+        "lm_head.weight": torch.ones(8, 4),
+    }
+    mapped = Model.hf_to_vllm_mapper.apply((nemo | hf).items())
+    decoder = ((name.removeprefix("language_model."), t) for name, t in mapped)
+    out = dict(_decoder_weights(decoder, vocab_size=10))
+    assert sorted(out) == [
+        "lm_head.weight",
+        "model.embed_tokens.weight",
+        "model.embeddings.weight",
+        "model.layers.0.mixer.A_log",
+        "model.layers.1.mixer.experts.0.down_proj.weight",
+        "model.layers.1.mixer.experts.0.up_proj.weight_scale",
+        "model.layers.1.mixer.experts.1.down_proj.weight",
+        "model.norm_f.weight",
+    ]
+    for name in (
+        "model.embed_tokens.weight",
+        "model.embeddings.weight",
+        "lm_head.weight",
+    ):
+        assert out[name].shape == (10, 4) and out[name][8:].eq(0).all()
+    assert torch.equal(
+        out["model.layers.1.mixer.experts.1.down_proj.weight"],
+        nemo["llm.model.layers.1.mixer.experts.down_projs"][1].t(),
+    )
+    # Names outside both layouts stay unmapped, so load_weights refuses them.
+    unknown = [("llm.vision.weight", torch.ones(1))]
+    assert [name for name, _ in Model.hf_to_vllm_mapper.apply(unknown)] == [
+        "llm.vision.weight"
+    ]
+

+def test_only_audio_has_a_placeholder():
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.nemotron3_5_transcribe import (

+def test_quantization_layer_names_map_onto_the_model():

+@pytest.mark.usefixtures("dist_init")
+def test_fp8_recipe_quantizes_the_asr_encoder_linear_layers():
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.modelopt import ModelOptFp8Config
+    from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.utils import configure_quant_config
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.nemotron3_5_transcribe import (
+        Nemotron3_5TranscribeForConditionalGeneration as Model,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.nemotron3_5_transcribe_audio import (
+        Nemotron3_5TranscribeAudioTower,
+    )
+
+    # As in the FP8 checkpoint's config.json.
+    quant_config = ModelOptFp8Config.from_config(
+        {
+            "quant_method": "modelopt",
+            "quant_algo": "FP8",
+            "config_groups": {
+                "group_0": {
+                    "targets": ["Linear"],
+                    "weights": {"dynamic": False, "num_bits": 8, "type": "float"},
+                    "input_activations": {
+                        "dynamic": False,
+                        "num_bits": 8,
+                        "type": "float",
+                    },
+                }
+            },
+            "ignore": [
+                "perception.encoder.diarization_model*",
+                "perception.encoder.asr_encoder.pre_encode*",
+                "perception.proj",
+            ],
+        }
+    )
+    configure_quant_config(quant_config, Model)
+    tower = Nemotron3_5TranscribeAudioTower(
+        TINY_AUDIO_CONFIG, quant_config=quant_config, prefix="audio_tower"
+    )
+    fp8_layers = sorted(
+        name
+        for name, module in tower.named_modules()
+        if isinstance(getattr(module, "weight", None), torch.Tensor)
+        and module.weight.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    assert fp8_layers == sorted(
+        f"encoder.asr_encoder.layers.{i}.{layer}"
+        for i in range(2)
+        for layer in ("attn.w_qkv", "attn.out_proj", "ffn.net.0", "ffn.net.3")
+    )
+
+    # The checkpoint stores each scale as a scalar.
+    weights = []
+    for name, target in [*tower.named_parameters(), *tower.named_buffers()]:
+        if name == "encoder.diar_kernel":
+            continue
+        tensor = torch.full(target.shape, 0.5).to(target.dtype)
+        if name.endswith("_scale"):
+            tensor = torch.tensor(0.25)
+        weights.append((name, tensor))

+def _num_audio_embeddings(audio_config: Mapping[str, Mapping], num_samples: int) -> int:
+    """Embeddings the audio tower produces for ``num_samples`` samples."""
+    preprocessor = audio_config["preprocessor"]
+    factor = audio_config["asr_encoder"]["subsampling_factor"]
+    n_fft = preprocessor["n_fft"]
+    num_frames = (num_samples + n_fft // 2 * 2 - n_fft) // preprocessor["hop_length"]
+    return (num_frames + factor - 1) // factor
+
+
+def _transcription_clip_s(
+    audio_config: Mapping[str, Mapping], max_model_len: int
+) -> int:
+    """Longest piece ``/v1/audio/transcriptions`` sends: at most an hour, and short
+    enough that its embeddings and transcript fit in the context."""
+    sample_rate = audio_config["preprocessor"]["sample_rate"]
+    hour = 3600
+    tokens_per_s = (
+        _num_audio_embeddings(audio_config, hour * sample_rate) / hour
+        + _TRANSCRIPT_TOKENS_PER_S
+    )
+    fits_s = int((max_model_len - _DUMMY_TEXT_TOKEN_RESERVE) / tokens_per_s)
+    return max(1, min(_MAX_TRANSCRIPTION_CLIP_S, fits_s))
+

+def _max_audio_samples(
+    audio_config: Mapping[str, Mapping], seq_len: int, override_samples: int | None
+) -> int:
+    """Longest audio whose embeddings fit in ``seq_len`` beside a short prompt."""
+    preprocessor = audio_config["preprocessor"]
+    min_samples = preprocessor["hop_length"]
+    limit = int(
+        override_samples or _DEFAULT_MAX_AUDIO_DURATION_S * preprocessor["sample_rate"]
+    )
+
+    def num_tokens(num_samples: int) -> int:
+        return _num_audio_embeddings(audio_config, max(num_samples, min_samples))
+
+    max_tokens = max(1, seq_len - _DUMMY_TEXT_TOKEN_RESERVE)
+    if num_tokens(limit) <= max_tokens:
+        return limit
+    low, high = min_samples, limit
+    while low < high:
+        mid = (low + high + 1) // 2
+        if num_tokens(mid) <= max_tokens:
+            low = mid
+        else:
+            high = mid - 1
+    return low

+class MelSpectrogram(nn.Module):
+    """Log-mel features as NeMo ``FilterbankFeatures`` computes them at inference.
+
+    Dither is off and no normalization is applied; frames past each row's
+    length are set to ``pad_value``. The filterbank and window come from the
+    checkpoint and are held in the model dtype, as in the reference, and are
+    upcast to float32 for the computation.

+    def __init__(self, cfg: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.n_fft = cfg["n_fft"]
+        self.hop_length = cfg["hop_length"]
+        self.win_length = cfg["win_length"]
+        self.preemph = cfg["preemph"]
+        self.log_zero_guard_value = cfg["log_zero_guard_value"]
+        self.mag_power = cfg["mag_power"]
+        self.pad_value = cfg["pad_value"]
+        self.register_buffer("fb", torch.zeros(1, cfg["n_mels"], self.n_fft // 2 + 1))
+        self.register_buffer("window", torch.zeros(self.win_length))
+
+    def get_seq_len(self, num_samples: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        pad_amount = self.n_fft // 2 * 2
+        seq_len = torch.floor_divide(
+            num_samples + pad_amount - self.n_fft, self.hop_length
+        ).to(torch.long)
+        return torch.where(num_samples == 0, torch.zeros_like(seq_len), seq_len)

+        self, audio: torch.Tensor, num_samples: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        seq_len = self.get_seq_len(num_samples)
+        x = audio.float()
+        if self.preemph:
+            time_mask = torch.arange(x.shape[1], device=x.device).unsqueeze(
+                0
+            ) < num_samples.unsqueeze(1)
+            x = torch.cat((x[:, :1], x[:, 1:] - self.preemph * x[:, :-1]), dim=1)
+            x = x.masked_fill(~time_mask, 0.0)

+            hop_length=self.hop_length,
+            win_length=self.win_length,
+            center=True,
+            window=self.window.float(),
+            return_complex=True,
+            pad_mode="constant",

+        x = torch.log(x + self.log_zero_guard_value)
+        pad_mask = torch.arange(x.shape[-1], device=x.device).unsqueeze(
+            0
+        ) >= seq_len.unsqueeze(1)

+    batch_size, _, max_time = x.shape

+        torch.arange(max_time, device=x.device)
+        .unsqueeze(0)
+        .expand(batch_size, max_time)
+    )
+    valid_mask = time_steps < seq_len.unsqueeze(1)
+    denominator = valid_mask.sum(dim=1)

+            return rotate(t)

+            (rotate(t[..., : self.rot_dim]), t[..., self.rot_dim :]), dim=-1
+        )
+
+
+class FeatureStacking(nn.Module):
+    """Stack ``factor`` consecutive frames and project them to the model width."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        factor: int,
+        feat_in: int,
+        feat_out: int,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.factor = factor
+        self.proj = _linear(
+            factor * feat_in,
+            feat_out,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.proj",
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self, x: torch.Tensor, lengths: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        x = x.transpose(1, 2)
+        batch_size, num_frames, channels = x.shape
+        pad = (self.factor - num_frames % self.factor) % self.factor
+        if pad:
+            x = F.pad(x, (0, 0, 0, pad))
+        x = x.reshape(
+            batch_size, (num_frames + pad) // self.factor, channels * self.factor
+        )
+        return self.proj(x), (lengths + self.factor - 1) // self.factor
+
+
+class MultiHeadAttention(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        cfg: dict[str, Any],
+        rope: RotaryEmbedding,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.d_model = cfg["d_model"]
+        self.n_heads = cfg["n_heads"]
+        self.head_dim = self.d_model // self.n_heads
+        self.rope = rope
+        self.w_qkv = _linear(
+            self.d_model,
+            3 * self.d_model,
+            bias=cfg["qkv_bias"],
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.w_qkv",
+        )
+        self.out_proj = _linear(
+            self.d_model,
+            self.d_model,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.out_proj",
+        )
+        self.qk_norm = cfg["qk_norm"]
+        if self.qk_norm:
+            self.q_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.head_dim)
+            self.k_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.head_dim)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_mask: torch.Tensor,
+        cos: torch.Tensor,
+        sin: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        batch_size, num_frames, _ = x.shape
+        qkv = self.w_qkv(x).view(batch_size, num_frames, 3, self.n_heads, self.head_dim)
+        q, k, v = qkv.permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4).unbind(0)
+        if self.qk_norm:
+            q = self.q_norm(q).to(v.dtype)
+            k = self.k_norm(k).to(v.dtype)
+        q = self.rope.apply(q, cos.to(q.dtype), sin.to(q.dtype))
+        k = self.rope.apply(k, cos.to(k.dtype), sin.to(k.dtype))
+        out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(q, k, v, attn_mask=attn_mask)
+        out = out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(batch_size, num_frames, self.d_model)
+        return self.out_proj(out)
+
+
+class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        cfg: dict[str, Any],
+        rope: RotaryEmbedding,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        d_model = cfg["d_model"]
+        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
+        self.attn = MultiHeadAttention(cfg, rope, quant_config, f"{prefix}.attn")
+        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(d_model)
+        ff_hidden = int(cfg["ff_expansion"] * d_model)
+        # Indices 0 and 3 match the checkpoint's ``ffn.net.{0,3}``.
+        self.ffn = nn.Module()
+        self.ffn.net = nn.Sequential(
+            _linear(
+                d_model,
+                ff_hidden,
+                bias=True,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.ffn.net.0",
+            ),
+            nn.GELU(),
+            nn.Identity(),
+            _linear(
+                ff_hidden,
+                d_model,
+                bias=True,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.ffn.net.3",
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_mask: torch.Tensor,
+        cos: torch.Tensor,
+        sin: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        x = x + self.attn(self.norm1(x), attn_mask, cos, sin)
+        return x + self.ffn.net(self.norm2(x))
+
+
+class TransformerEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """NeMo ``TransformerEncoder`` with RoPE and full attention, at inference.
+
+    ``forward`` takes ``(B, C, T)`` mel features, or ``(B, T, d_model)``
+    pre-encoded embeddings with ``bypass_pre_encode=True``, and returns
+    ``(B, d_model, T')`` states with their lengths. Only keys are masked, so
+    padded frames never influence valid ones.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        cfg: dict[str, Any],
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.d_model = cfg["d_model"]
+        self.subsampling_factor = cfg["subsampling_factor"]
+        self.pre_encode = FeatureStacking(
+            self.subsampling_factor,
+            cfg["feat_in"],
+            self.d_model,
+            quant_config,
+            f"{prefix}.pre_encode",
+        )
+        self.xscale = math.sqrt(self.d_model) if cfg["xscaling"] else None
+        self.rope = RotaryEmbedding(
+            self.d_model // cfg["n_heads"], cfg["rotary_fraction"], cfg["rope_base"]
+        )
+        self.embed_norm = (
+            nn.LayerNorm(self.d_model) if cfg["pre_block_norm"] else nn.Identity()
+        )
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                TransformerBlock(cfg, self.rope, quant_config, f"{prefix}.layers.{i}")
+                for i in range(cfg["n_layers"])
+            ]
+        )
+        self.final_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.d_model)
+
+    def forward(
+        self, x: torch.Tensor, lengths: torch.Tensor, bypass_pre_encode: bool = False
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        if not bypass_pre_encode:
+            x, lengths = self.pre_encode(x, lengths)
+        lengths = lengths.to(torch.int64)
+        if self.xscale:
+            x = x * self.xscale
+        x = self.embed_norm(x)
+        num_frames = x.shape[1]
+        positions = torch.arange(num_frames, device=x.device).unsqueeze(0)
+        # A row with no valid frame (a short clip in a later window) attends to
+        # frame 0 to stay finite; its outputs are discarded.
+        key_mask = (positions < lengths.unsqueeze(1)) | (
+            (positions == 0) & (lengths.unsqueeze(1) == 0)
+        )
+        attn_mask = key_mask[:, None, None, :]
+        cos, sin = self.rope.cos_sin(num_frames, x.dtype, x.device)
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            x = layer(x, attn_mask, cos, sin)
+        return self.final_norm(x).transpose(1, 2), lengths
+
+
+def downsample_preds(preds: torch.Tensor, factor: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Average ``(B, T, S)`` probabilities over windows of ``factor`` frames."""
+    if factor == 1 or preds.shape[1] == 0:
+        return preds
+    pooled = F.avg_pool1d(
+        preds.transpose(1, 2),
+        kernel_size=factor,
+        stride=factor,
+        ceil_mode=True,
+        count_include_pad=False,
+    )
+    return pooled.transpose(1, 2)
+
+
+def align_frames(preds: torch.Tensor, target_len: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pad with the last frame, or truncate, ``(B, T, S)`` to ``target_len`` frames."""
+    current_len = preds.shape[1]
+    if current_len < target_len:
+        if current_len == 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Speaker activity cannot be empty when the encoder output is not."
+            )
+        preds = torch.cat(
+            [preds, preds[:, -1:].repeat(1, target_len - current_len, 1)], dim=1
+        )
+    return preds[:, :target_len]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SpeakerCacheState:
+    """Synchronous streaming state of the Sortformer speaker encoder."""
+
+    spkcache: torch.Tensor
+    fifo: torch.Tensor
+    spkcache_preds: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    spkcache_compressed: bool = False
+
+
+class SortformerModules(nn.Module):
+    """Speaker head and speaker cache of NeMo ``SortformerModules`` at inference."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        cfg: dict[str, Any],
+        online: dict[str, Any],
+        upsample_factor: int,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.n_spk = cfg["num_speakers"]
+        self.upsample_factor = upsample_factor
+        hidden = cfg["tf_d_model"]
+        self.encoder_proj = _linear(
+            cfg["fc_d_model"],
+            hidden,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.encoder_proj",
+        )
+        self.subpixel_upsample = nn.Conv1d(
+            hidden, hidden * upsample_factor, kernel_size=3, padding=1
+        )
+        self.first_hidden_to_hidden = _linear(
+            hidden,
+            hidden,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.first_hidden_to_hidden",
+        )
+        self.single_hidden_to_spks = _linear(
+            hidden,
+            self.n_spk,
+            bias=True,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.single_hidden_to_spks",
+        )
+        self.learnable_sil_emb = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(cfg["fc_d_model"]))
+
+        self.fifo_len = online["fifo_len"]
+        self.spkcache_len = online["spkcache_len"]
+        self.spkcache_update_period = online["spkcache_update_period"]
+        self.sil_frames_per_spk = cfg["spkcache_sil_frames_per_spk"]
+        self.pred_score_threshold = cfg["pred_score_threshold"]
+        self.max_index = cfg["max_index"]
+        self.scores_boost_latest = cfg["scores_boost_latest"]
+        self.strong_boost_rate = cfg["strong_boost_rate"]
+        self.weak_boost_rate = cfg["weak_boost_rate"]
+        self.min_pos_scores_rate = cfg["min_pos_scores_rate"]
+        if self.spkcache_len < (1 + self.sil_frames_per_spk) * self.n_spk:
+            raise ValueError("spkcache_len is too small for the number of speakers.")
+
+    def speaker_probs(
+        self, hidden: torch.Tensor, lengths: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Upsampled speaker probabilities, ``(B, T * upsample_factor, n_spk)``."""
+        batch_size, num_frames, width = hidden.shape
+        mask = torch.arange(num_frames, device=hidden.device).unsqueeze(
+            0
+        ) < lengths.unsqueeze(1)
+        # The convolution reads neighbouring frames: zero the padding so a clip's
+        # last frame does not depend on the clips batched with it.
+        hidden = hidden.masked_fill(~mask.unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)
+        upsampled = self.subpixel_upsample(hidden.transpose(1, 2)).transpose(1, 2)
+        upsampled = upsampled.reshape(
+            batch_size, num_frames, self.upsample_factor, width
+        ).reshape(batch_size, num_frames * self.upsample_factor, width)
+        logits = self.single_hidden_to_spks(
+            F.relu(self.first_hidden_to_hidden(F.relu(upsampled)))
+        )
+        output_mask = mask.repeat_interleave(self.upsample_factor, dim=1)
+        return torch.sigmoid(logits) * output_mask.unsqueeze(-1)
+
+    def update(
+        self,
+        state: SpeakerCacheState,
+        chunk: torch.Tensor,
+        preds: torch.Tensor,
+        lc: int,
+        rc: int,
+    ) -> SpeakerCacheState:
+        """NeMo ``SortformerModules.streaming_update`` (synchronous)."""
+        spkcache_len, fifo_len = state.spkcache.shape[1], state.fifo.shape[1]
+        chunk_len = chunk.shape[1] - lc - rc
+        fifo_preds = preds[:, spkcache_len : spkcache_len + fifo_len]
+        chunk = chunk[:, lc : chunk_len + lc]
+        chunk_preds = preds[
+            :, spkcache_len + fifo_len + lc : spkcache_len + fifo_len + chunk_len + lc
+        ]
+        fifo = torch.cat([state.fifo, chunk], dim=1)
+        fifo_preds = torch.cat([fifo_preds, chunk_preds], dim=1)
+        spkcache, spkcache_preds, compressed = (
+            state.spkcache,
+            state.spkcache_preds,
+            state.spkcache_compressed,
+        )
+
+        if fifo_len + chunk_len > self.fifo_len:
+            pop_out_len = max(
+                self.spkcache_update_period, chunk_len - self.fifo_len + fifo_len
+            )
+            pop_out_len = min(pop_out_len, fifo_len + chunk_len)
+            pop_out_embs, pop_out_preds = (
+                fifo[:, :pop_out_len],
+                fifo_preds[:, :pop_out_len],
+            )
+            fifo = fifo[:, pop_out_len:]
+            spkcache = torch.cat([spkcache, pop_out_embs], dim=1)
+            if compressed:
+                spkcache_preds = torch.cat([spkcache_preds, pop_out_preds], dim=1)
+            else:
+                spkcache_preds = torch.cat(
+                    [preds[:, :spkcache_len], pop_out_preds], dim=1
+                )
+            if spkcache.shape[1] > self.spkcache_len:
+                spkcache, spkcache_preds = self._compress_spkcache(
+                    spkcache, spkcache_preds
+                )
+                compressed = True
+        return SpeakerCacheState(spkcache, fifo, spkcache_preds, compressed)
+
+    def _compress_spkcache(
+        self, emb_seq: torch.Tensor, preds: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Keep the ``spkcache_len`` most informative frames, as NeMo does."""
+        batch_size, _, n_spk = preds.shape
+        per_spk = self.spkcache_len // n_spk - self.sil_frames_per_spk
+        strong_boost = math.floor(per_spk * self.strong_boost_rate)
+        weak_boost = math.floor(per_spk * self.weak_boost_rate)
+        min_pos_scores = math.floor(per_spk * self.min_pos_scores_rate)
+
+        threshold = self.pred_score_threshold
+        log_probs = torch.log(torch.clamp(preds, min=threshold))
+        log_1_probs = torch.log(torch.clamp(1.0 - preds, min=threshold))
+        log_1_probs_sum = log_1_probs.sum(dim=2).unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, n_spk)
+        scores = log_probs - log_1_probs + log_1_probs_sum - math.log(0.5)
+
+        is_speech = preds > 0.5
+        scores = torch.where(is_speech, scores, float("-inf"))
+        is_pos = scores > 0
+        replace = (
+            (~is_pos) * is_speech * (is_pos.sum(dim=1).unsqueeze(1) >= min_pos_scores)
+        )
+        scores = torch.where(replace, float("-inf"), scores)
+
+        if self.scores_boost_latest > 0:
+            scores[:, self.spkcache_len :, :] += self.scores_boost_latest
+        scores = self._boost_topk_scores(scores, strong_boost, scale_factor=2)
+        scores = self._boost_topk_scores(scores, weak_boost, scale_factor=1)
+        if self.sil_frames_per_spk > 0:
+            pad = torch.full(
+                (batch_size, self.sil_frames_per_spk, n_spk),
+                float("inf"),
+                dtype=scores.dtype,
+                device=scores.device,
+            )
+            scores = torch.cat([scores, pad], dim=1)
+
+        num_frames = scores.shape[1]
+        flat = scores.permute(0, 2, 1).reshape(batch_size, -1)
+        topk_values, topk_indices = torch.topk(
+            flat, self.spkcache_len, dim=1, sorted=False
+        )
+        topk_indices = torch.where(
+            topk_values != float("-inf"), topk_indices, self.max_index
+        )
+        topk_indices, _ = torch.sort(topk_indices, dim=1)
+        is_disabled = topk_indices == self.max_index
+        topk_indices = torch.remainder(topk_indices, num_frames)
+        is_disabled += topk_indices >= num_frames - self.sil_frames_per_spk
+        topk_indices[is_disabled] = 0
+
+        sil_emb = (
+            self.learnable_sil_emb.to(dtype=emb_seq.dtype)
+            .unsqueeze(0)
+            .expand(batch_size, -1)
+        )
+        emb_gathered = torch.gather(
+            emb_seq, 1, topk_indices.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, emb_seq.shape[2])
+        )
+        emb_gathered = torch.where(
+            is_disabled.unsqueeze(-1),
+            sil_emb.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, self.spkcache_len, -1),
+            emb_gathered,
+        )
+        preds_gathered = torch.gather(
+            preds, 1, topk_indices.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, n_spk)
+        )
+        preds_gathered = torch.where(is_disabled.unsqueeze(-1), 0.0, preds_gathered)
+        return emb_gathered, preds_gathered
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _boost_topk_scores(
+        scores: torch.Tensor, n_boost_per_spk: int, scale_factor: float
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        batch_size, _, n_spk = scores.shape
+        _, topk_indices = torch.topk(
+            scores, n_boost_per_spk, dim=1, largest=True, sorted=False
+        )
+        batch_indices = torch.arange(batch_size, device=scores.device).view(-1, 1, 1)
+        speaker_indices = torch.arange(n_spk, device=scores.device).view(1, 1, -1)
+        scores[batch_indices, topk_indices, speaker_indices] -= scale_factor * math.log(
+            0.5
+        )
+        return scores
+
+
+class SortformerSpeakerEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """Streaming inference of the high-resolution Sortformer in NeMo's PEE.
+
+    Mirrors ``SortformerEncLabelModel.forward_streaming_step`` for synchronous
+    streaming without speaker permutation. Each step returns speaker
+    probabilities on the encoder frame grid for the window's core frames.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        encoder_cfg: dict[str, Any],
+        sortformer_cfg: dict[str, Any],
+        online: dict[str, Any],
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.encoder = TransformerEncoder(
+            encoder_cfg, quant_config, f"{prefix}.encoder"
+        )
+        self.subsampling_factor = encoder_cfg["subsampling_factor"]
+        self.sortformer_modules = SortformerModules(
+            sortformer_cfg,
+            online,
+            self.subsampling_factor,
+            quant_config,
+            f"{prefix}.sortformer_modules",
+        )
+        self.fc_d_model = sortformer_cfg["fc_d_model"]
+        self.n_spk = sortformer_cfg["num_speakers"]
+
+    def init_state(
+        self, batch_size: int, dtype: torch.dtype, device: torch.device
+    ) -> SpeakerCacheState:
+        empty = torch.zeros(
+            (batch_size, 0, self.fc_d_model), dtype=dtype, device=device
+        )
+        return SpeakerCacheState(spkcache=empty, fifo=empty.clone())
+
+    def step(
+        self,
+        features: torch.Tensor,
+        lengths: torch.Tensor,
+        state: SpeakerCacheState,
+        left_offset: int,
+        right_offset: int,
+    ) -> tuple[SpeakerCacheState, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Process one window of ``(B, C, T)`` mel features.
+
+        Returns the new state and the core frames' speaker probabilities on the
+        encoder grid.
+        """
+        modules = self.sortformer_modules
+        factor = self.subsampling_factor
+        chunk_embs, chunk_lengths = self.encoder.pre_encode(features, lengths)
+        embs = torch.cat([state.spkcache, state.fifo, chunk_embs], dim=1)
+        context_len = state.spkcache.shape[1] + state.fifo.shape[1]
+        emb_lengths = context_len + chunk_lengths
+        states, state_lengths = self.encoder(embs, emb_lengths, bypass_pre_encode=True)
+        hidden = modules.encoder_proj(states.transpose(1, 2))
+        high_res_preds = modules.speaker_probs(hidden, state_lengths)
+
+        lc = round(left_offset / factor)
+        rc = math.ceil(right_offset / factor)
+        preds = downsample_preds(high_res_preds, modules.upsample_factor)
+        valid = torch.arange(preds.shape[1], device=preds.device).view(
+            1, -1, 1
+        ) < state_lengths.view(-1, 1, 1)
+        preds = torch.where(valid, preds, 0.0)
+        state = modules.update(state, chunk_embs, preds, lc, rc)
+
+        chunk_len = chunk_embs.shape[1] - lc - rc
+        start = (context_len + lc) * modules.upsample_factor
+        chunk_preds = high_res_preds[
+            :, start : start + chunk_len * modules.upsample_factor
+        ]
+        return state, downsample_preds(chunk_preds, factor)
+
+
+class ParallelExpertEncoder(nn.Module):
+    """NeMo ``ParallelExpertEncoder`` online inference with a transformer ASR encoder.
+
+    ``forward`` takes unnormalized ``(B, C, T)`` mel features and returns the
+    fused ``(B, d_model, T')`` states.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        audio_config: dict[str, Any],
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        online = audio_config["online"]
+        fusion = audio_config["fusion"]
+        self.asr_encoder = TransformerEncoder(
+            audio_config["asr_encoder"],
+            quant_config,
+            f"{prefix}.asr_encoder",
+        )
+        self.diarization_model = SortformerSpeakerEncoder(
+            audio_config["speaker_encoder"],
+            audio_config["sortformer"],
+            online,
+            quant_config,
+            f"{prefix}.diarization_model",
+        )
+        self.subsampling_factor = self.asr_encoder.subsampling_factor
+        self.window_feat_len = online["window_frames"] * self.subsampling_factor
+        self.left_ctx_feat_len = online["left_context_frames"] * self.subsampling_factor
+        self.right_ctx_feat_len = (
+            online["right_context_frames"] * self.subsampling_factor
+        )
+        self.speaker_feature_mode = fusion["speaker_feature_mode"]
+        self.speaker_activity_threshold = fusion["speaker_activity_threshold"]
+        self.spk_kernel_scale = fusion["spk_kernel_scale"]
+        n_spk = self.diarization_model.n_spk
+        self.asr_norm = nn.LayerNorm(self.asr_encoder.d_model)
+        self.diar_norm = nn.LayerNorm(n_spk)
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "diar_kernel",
+            self._sinusoid_kernel(n_spk, self.asr_encoder.d_model),
+            persistent=False,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _sinusoid_kernel(num_speakers: int, width: int) -> torch.Tensor:

+def _encoder_config(cfg: dict[str, Any], name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Resolve a NeMo ``TransformerEncoder`` config, applying its defaults."""
+    subsampling = cfg.get("subsampling", "feature_stacking")
+    if subsampling != "feature_stacking":
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name}: only feature_stacking subsampling is supported, "
+            f"got {subsampling!r}."
+        )
+    if cfg.get("self_attention_model", "rel_pos") != "rope":
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: only rope self-attention is supported.")
+    if cfg.get("attn_mode", "full") != "full":
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: only full attention is supported.")
+    if int(cfg.get("causal_tail_len", 0)) != 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name}: causal_tail_len must be 0 at inference.")
+    feat_out = int(cfg.get("feat_out", -1))
+    d_model = int(cfg["d_model"])
+    if feat_out > 0 and feat_out != d_model:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"{name}: an output projection (feat_out={feat_out}) is not supported."
+        )
+    return {
+        "feat_in": int(cfg.get("feat_in", 128)),
+        "d_model": d_model,
+        "n_heads": int(cfg["n_heads"]),
+        "n_layers": int(cfg["n_layers"]),
+        "ff_expansion": float(cfg.get("ff_expansion", 4.0)),
+        "qkv_bias": bool(cfg.get("qkv_bias", False)),
+        "qk_norm": bool(cfg.get("qk_norm", False)),
+        "pre_block_norm": bool(cfg.get("pre_block_norm", True)),
+        "subsampling_factor": int(cfg.get("subsampling_factor", 4)),
+        "rope_base": float(cfg.get("rope_base", 10000.0)),
+        "rotary_fraction": float(cfg.get("rotary_fraction", 1.0)),
+        "xscaling": bool(cfg.get("xscaling", False)),
+    }

+def _preprocessor_config(cfg: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Resolve a NeMo ``AudioToMelSpectrogramPreprocessor`` config."""
+    sample_rate = int(cfg.get("sample_rate", 16000))
+    # NeMo normalizes per feature when the key is missing.
+    if cfg.get("normalize", "per_feature") not in (None, "", "NA"):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "The perception preprocessor must not normalize; the encoders normalize "
+            "their inputs."
+        )
+    if bool(cfg.get("exact_pad", False)):
+        raise ValueError("exact_pad preprocessing is not supported.")
+    if int(cfg.get("frame_splicing", 1)) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("frame_splicing is not supported.")
+    if cfg.get("window", "hann") != "hann":
+        raise ValueError("Only the hann window is supported.")
+    if not bool(cfg.get("log", True)):
+        raise ValueError("Only log-mel features are supported (log=true).")
+    if cfg.get("log_zero_guard_type", "add") != "add":
+        raise ValueError("Only log_zero_guard_type='add' is supported.")
+    win_length = int(float(cfg.get("window_size", 0.02)) * sample_rate)
+    return {
+        "sample_rate": sample_rate,
+        "win_length": win_length,
+        "hop_length": int(float(cfg.get("window_stride", 0.01)) * sample_rate),
+        # NeMo's default: the next power of two at or above the window length.
+        "n_fft": int(cfg.get("n_fft") or 2 ** math.ceil(math.log2(win_length))),
+        "n_mels": int(cfg.get("features", 64)),
+        "preemph": float(cfg.get("preemph", 0.97)),
+        "log_zero_guard_value": float(cfg.get("log_zero_guard_value", 2**-24)),
+        "mag_power": float(cfg.get("mag_power", 2.0)),

+def _checked_online(online: dict[str, int]) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """Reject window settings the native encoders do not implement."""
+    if online["window_frames"] <= 0:

+        if online[key] <= 0:

+    return online

+    ) -> None:
+        # Transformers may read the text config while the base class
+        # initializes; give it the real one before calling super().__init__.
+        if llm_config is not None or text_config is None:
+            self.text_config = _build_text_config(llm_config)
+        elif isinstance(text_config, PreTrainedConfig):
+            self.text_config = text_config
+        else:
+            self.text_config = _build_text_config(text_config)
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        if self.architectures and self.architectures != [_ARCHITECTURE]:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Only {_ARCHITECTURE} is supported among NeMo SpeechLM checkpoints, "
+                f"got architectures={self.architectures!r}. "
+                + _other_architecture_hint(pe_encoder_config, self.text_config)
+            )
+
+        self.llm_config = llm_config
+        self.perception = perception or {}
+        self.pe_encoder_config = pe_encoder_config or {}
+
+        decoder_config = self.text_config
+        architectures = _decoder_architectures(decoder_config)
+        if len(architectures) != 1 or architectures[0] not in _HYBRID_ARCHITECTURES:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Expected a NemotronH decoder, got architectures={architectures!r}."
+            )
+        decoder_config.architectures = [_DECODER_ARCHITECTURE]
+
+        if (
+            llm_config is not None
+            and getattr(decoder_config, "speechlm_output_vocab_size", None) is None
+        ):
+            decoder_config.speechlm_output_vocab_size = int(decoder_config.vocab_size)
+            decoder_config.vocab_size = (
+                int(decoder_config.vocab_size) + SPEECHLM_EMBED_EXTRA_ROWS
+            )
+        self.output_vocab_size = int(
+            getattr(
+                decoder_config, "speechlm_output_vocab_size", decoder_config.vocab_size
+            )
+        )
+
+        if self.perception:
+            self.audio_config = resolve_audio_config(
+                self.perception, self.pe_encoder_config
+            )
+        else:
+            self.audio_config = audio_config or {}
+
+    def get_text_config(self, decoder: bool = False) -> PreTrainedConfig:
+        return self.text_config
